# One line for each golden directory of the kitchen protos: <directory>|<options of protoc-gen-swift>
default|
public|Visibility=Public,FileNaming=PathToUnderscores
dropped-path|FileNaming=DropPath
nonexhaustive|EnumGeneration=nonexhaustive,Visibility=Public
hidden-names|ExperimentalHiddenNames=All
stripped|experimental_strip_nonfunctional_codegen
renamed-runtime|SwiftProtobufModuleName=SPB,Visibility=Public
implementation-only|ImplementationOnlyImports=true
package-access|Visibility=Package,UseAccessLevelOnImports=true
